title: Induced planar Turán numbers
summary: The planar Turá number of a graph $F$ is the maximum number of edges an $n$-vertex $F$-free planar graph can have. We study the case where $F$ is forbidden as an induced subgraph, thereby introducing the induced planar Turá numbers. We will determine a sharp upper bound when $F$ is $Θ_4$, a $4$-cycle with a diagonal edge, and obtain exact extremal values in case $F$ is a path $P_k$ on $k$ vertices, for $k=3,4$ and $5$.
